Trigger monitor … Optional early-stop if a high-confidence trigger appears.

features.quote: Do not use emotionally loaded feedback such as: 'You failed again. Your previous fix was bad.'
features.justification_quote: That would confound task-induced meltdown with evaluator-induced social pressure.
